objective: Define the smallest patch-fix boundary after the first Verilator overlay patch build-only validation reached verilator_bin but failed to compile.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The previous patch applies but is structurally unsafe because zero-context hunks can land outside the intended class/function regions. The compile fix must regenerate contextual hunks before any new build-success, parser-behavior, or native-support claim.
reason: the descriptor and patch path are already the accepted repo-owned overlay boundary
the observed failure is patch placement, not a need for a broader source surface
keeping the existing patch path preserves the active surface and avoids introducing a second competing patch artifact
the next implementation can update descriptor metadata to point at this compile-fix gate if needed

observed_failure.header_failure: V3Options.h fields and accessors landed after '#endif  // guard'
observed_failure.cpp_failure: V3Options.cpp parse and notify hunks also landed after optimize(), so their semantic content must be regenerated with contextual anchors rather than preserved as zero-context hunks

v3options_h_public_string_accessor_ancho.insert_after: string protectKeyDefaulted() VL_MT_SAFE;  // Set default key if not set by user

v3options_cpp_notify_anchor.insert_after: cmdfl->v3error("--make cannot be used together with --build. Suggest see manual");
v3options_cpp_notify_anchor.required_context: inside V3Options::notify() before backend mutual-exclusion checks

v3options_cpp_positive_count_parser_anch.required_context: inside V3Options::parseOptsList() before DECL_OPTION usage comments

rerun_boundary_after_fix.verilator_install_policy: use explicit VERILATOR_INSTALL or the previously accepted checkout-local generated install prefix; do not leave configure --prefix empty

parser_behavior_execution: run the built Verilator binary with --sim-accel sidecar-gpu --sim-accel-states N --sim-accel-steps S
reject unknown accelerators through the built Verilator binary
reject missing state/step halves through the built Verilator binary

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_compile_fix_gate
must_decide: whether in-place patch repair is still the smallest safe source boundary
whether the chosen V3Options.h anchors keep all fields and accessors inside the class
whether the chosen V3Options.cpp anchors keep notify, parser helper, and option registrations inside the intended functions
whether the next implementation may update only the patch/descriptor plus source-of-truth/test/doc alignment
whether the rerun boundary is enough before any parser-behavior gate
must_not_claim: Verilator builds with the fixed patch

non_claims: not a landed upstream Verilator patch
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
